_note: Frozen whole-game folds for scripts/microstructure_eval.py. discovery = every NFL game dated 2026-09-20/21 (discovery_dates is the rule; the list records the 15 recorded games) - the games the LAG rule was designed on, never validation or test. validation = NFL games after discovery and before test_from. test = every NFL game with an ET event date >= test_from, the verified week-5 kickoff (test_kickoff), defined by rule before any was recorded. Every run is appended to out/eval_log.jsonl with the hash of the complete effective spec; a test run under a spec other than the first test opening needs --reopen-test and is reported as exploratory.

h2.dip: down trigger: dmid_30 <= -0.05 with bid and ask each confirming >= 40 %, same sign; buy into the fall
h2.recovery: fell >= 5c peak-to-trough within 60 s, mid now >= 1c above that trough, bid and ask both up over 5 s; buy the observed bounce; once per contract per 60 s
h2.note: unchanged from v3: dip and recovery stay separate registered rules

spec.momentum_candidate: M_prototype = strategy/momentum.MomentumTracker at its defaults; buy on status 'rising'; forecast = projected_mid over its horizon_s

decision_rules.reject: skill CI includes 0 or is below it
decision_rules.shadow: net P&L CI includes 0, fill rate < 0.60, < 30 test games, < 200 deduplicated decisions, or one game > 40 % of P&L
decision_rules.alert_only_eligible: positive net P&L CI at L=3 s, haircut 0.5, both fees, >= 60 % positive games (no alert is created)

tests.p_value: one-sided game-level sign-flip randomization test of H0 'game totals symmetric about 0' vs mean > 0 (exact for <= 16 games, else 2000 fixed-seed draws)
tests.secondary: Holm over the secondary list at alpha; the primary never in it

spec.decisions_to_trades: a decision buys the contract (+1) or its executable complement (-1: same event, market and book, paying on the other outcome and 1 - its tie payout on a tie, observed fresh at the decision); H1 and H3 are symmetric; one economic exposure (event, book, outcome paid on) trades once per signal_cooldown_s; unavailable complements are counted

4: H1 and H3 symmetric through executable complements; mirror signals deduplicated by economic exposure
Robinhood single-leg orders at manual_leg_latency_s (a person places them)
all four latencies_s x haircuts executions reported; decisions stress at L=3 s, haircut 0.5
p-value: game-level sign-flip test replaces the uncentered bootstrap share
H3 counts a leader only with settlement identity (equal tie payouts, verbatim identical registry rules)
simultaneous observations processed atomically; settlement values keyed by book and contract
3: discovery by date; verified week-5 kickoff; chronological frozen forecast models; H2 dip vs recovery; spec hash and audit log
